lines.quote: Designed and simulated a minimum-variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamformer for a 12-element L-band phased-array antenna, targeting interference suppression in a multi-jammer environment.
Wrote and maintain the real-time DSP firmware in C for the company's digital receiver module, running on a Xilinx Zynq SoC.

Responsible for RF front-end characterisation on the digital receiver: conducted gain flatness and noise-figure measurements with a spectrum analyser and signal generator across the 1-6 GHz operating band, and ran antenna pattern measurements in the company's anechoic chamber for two product variants.

Worked as part of the integration team during flight-test campaigns on two airborne surveillance platforms, supporting installation, cable routing verification, and real-time data validation during test flights.
Since returning from leave in 2023, have been leading a four-person firmware subteam responsible for the digital receiver's signal processing chain.
Finnish citizen with full EU work authorisation.

All work at Kajanti is conducted in English -- the team includes Finnish, Japanese, and Estonian engineers, and English is the company's working language for all documentation, reviews, and daily communication.
I would relocate to Oulu regardless, and having a professional reason makes it simpler to set a date.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards, such as code that is tested and maintained by others?
